versions.subject: Bump versions for every detection, since everything will have a different conf stanza due to added fields. Don't re-bump things that already had their version bumped after the last release - this is a check that now causes a contentctl inspect failure. Finally, update all of the versions to today since this is the last time that the contents of the stanza is different.
